reference.title: Scenario 2 — No Title style applied
reference.shortdesc: Consider a document saved as Installation_Guide.docx with no Title style applied anywhere in the document.

section.p: Consider a document saved as Installation_Guide.docx with no Title style applied anywhere in the document. Because the document does not contain a styled title, the converter falls back to the document filename when generating the DITA map title.

row.entry: Document Name: Installation_Guide.docx Document Title: Not applied

section.p: Result:When the Title style is not applied, the converter uses the document filename (excluding the .docx extension) as the fallback title value. The generated map title preserves the original filename characters, including underscores and abbreviations.
section.note: Always apply the Title style to the document title. If the filename is an abbreviation or code, a missing Title style produces an unreadable root map title.
